title: Joy of a city
introduction: In this chapter Valmiki narrates various rituals undertaken by Rama the crown prince, along with his wife Seetha, on the eve of his anointment ceremony. The festivities in Ayodhya, the happiness of the people with King Dasaratha's decision to anoint Rama are also described here. Also, people from different directions arrive in Ayodhya to be there on the grand occasion.
closing: * Gayatri is an ancient meter of twenty-four syllables as a triplet of eight syllables each (Rigveda iii-62-10: - tat savitur varenyam bhargo devasya dhimahi dhiyo yo nah prachodayat) addressed to Savitri or the Sun as generator. Gayatri personified is considered as the mother of the first three classes viz. priestly class, warrior - class and the trader-class in their capacity of twice born.
|| इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये अयोध्यकाण्डे षष्ठः सर्गः ||
Thus completes 6th Chapter of Ayodhya Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
गते पुरोहिते रामः स्नातो नियतमानसः |
सह पत्न्या विशालाक्ष्या नारायणमुपागमत्
verses.iast:
gate purohite rāmaḥ snāto niyatamānasaḥ |
saha patnyā viśālākśyā nārāyaṇamupāgamat
verses.translation: After Vasistha left, Rama took bath and meditated on Lord Narayana with undistracted mind along with his wide-eyed wife, Seetha.

verses.devanagari:
प्रगृह्य शिरसा पात्रं हविषो विधिवत्तदा |
महते दैवतायाज्यं जुहाव ज्वलितानले
verses.iast:
pragṛhya śirasā pātraṃ haviśho vidhivattadā |
mahate daivatāyājyaṃ juhāva jvalitānale
verses.translation: Taking the vessel with clarified butter on his head as per scriptures, he offered to Lord Vishnu the clarified butter, by dropping it into the blazing fire.

glosses.meaning: as per ordinance of the scriptures

verses.devanagari:
शेषं च हविषस्तस्य प्राश्याशास्यात्मनः प्रियम् |
ध्यायन्नारायणं देवं स्वास्तीर्णे कुशसंस्तरे
वाग्यतः सह वैदेह्या भूत्वा नियतमानसः |
श्रीमत्यायतने विष्णोः शिश्ये नरवरात्मजः
verses.iast:
śeśhaṃ ca haviśhastasya prāśyāśāsyātmanaḥ priyam |
dhyāyannārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ svāstīrṇe kuśasaṃstare
vāgyataḥ saha vaidehyā bhūtvā niyatamānasaḥ |
śrīmatyāyatane viśhṇoḥ śiśye naravarātmajaḥ
verses.translation: Rama ate the remainder of clarified butter after finishing the sacrifice, which he performed for his own good, silently meditated on Lord Narayana with controlled mind and slept along with Seetha on a properly laid bed of Kusa grass in a splendid temple of Lord Vishnu. *
notes: * The learned commentators point out that the deity referred to here is no other than Lord Ranganatha, who had been worshipped by a long line of rulers of Ayodhya as their chosen deity in a separate shrine built within the precincts of the royal palace. We are told at length in the Patala Khanda of Padma Purana how Rama so kindly handed over the image to Vibhishana; through whom it reached Srirangam (near Tiruchirapally) in South India; where it exists even to this day and is held in the highest reverence by the Vaishnavas and other devotees all over India.

verses.devanagari:
एकयामावशिष्टायां रात्र्यां प्रतिविबुध्य सः |
अलञ्कारविधिं कृत्स्नं कारयामास वेश्मनः
verses.iast:
ekayāmāvaśiśhṭāyāṃ rātryāṃ prativibudhya saḥ |
alaJṇkāravidhiṃ kṛtsnaṃ kārayāmāsa veśmanaḥ
verses.translation: Rama woke up three hours before dawn and caused to complete the entire decoration of the house.

glosses.meaning: with three hours of night yet remaining

verses.devanagari:
तत्र शृण्वन् सुखा वाचः सूतमागधवन्दिनाम् |
पूर्वां सन्ध्यामुपासीनो जजाप यतमानसः
verses.iast:
tatra śṛṇvan sukhā vācaḥ sūtamāgadhavandinām |
pūrvāṃ sandhyāmupāsīno jajāpa yatamānasaḥ
verses.translation: Listening to the pleasing verses of professional reciters, he worshipped the early sunrise and meditated on Gayatri* with an undistracted mind.

verses.devanagari:
तुष्टाव प्रणतश्चैव शिरसा मधुसूदनम् |
विमलक्षौमसंवीतो वाचयामास च द्विजान्
verses.iast:
tuśhṭāva praṇataścaiva śirasā madhusūdanam |
vimalakśaumasaṃvīto vācayāmāsa ca dvijān
verses.translation: He praised Lord Vishnu by bowing his head before Him. By wearing pure silk clothes, he got valedictory text recited by Brahmans.

verses.devanagari:
तेषां पुण्याहघोषोऽध गम्भीरमधुरस्तदा |
अयोध्यां पूरयामास तूर्यघोषानुनादितः
verses.iast:
teśhāṃ puṇyāhaghośho'dha gambhīramadhurastadā |
ayodhyāṃ pūrayāmāsa tūryaghośhānunāditaḥ
verses.translation: Their deep and sweet chorus of the valedictory, united with the accompanying musical instruments, then filled the city of Ayodhya.

glosses.meaning: united with sound of musical instruments

verses.devanagari:
कृतोपवासं तु तदा वैदेह्या सह राघवम् |
अयोध्यानिलयः श्रुत्वा सर्वः प्रमुदितो जनः
verses.iast:
kṛtopavāsaṃ tu tadā vaidehyā saha rāghavam |
ayodhyānilayaḥ śrutvā sarvaḥ pramudito janaḥ
verses.translation: All the people residing in Ayodhya were delighted when they heard that Rama and Seetha had observed fast for the ensuing anointment ceremony.

verses.devanagari:
ततः पौरजनः सर्वः श्रुत्वा रामाभिषेचनम् |
प्रभातां रजनीं दृष्ट्वा चक्रे शोभयितुं पुरीम्
verses.iast:
tataḥ paurajanaḥ sarvaḥ śrutvā rāmābhiśhecanam |
prabhātāṃ rajanīṃ dṛśhṭvā cakre śobhayituṃ purīm
verses.translation: All the citizens decorated the town for coronation function of Rama, soon before sunrise.

verses.devanagari:
सिताभ्रशिखराभेषु देवतायतनेषु च |
ङ्��चतुष्पधेषु रध्यासु चैत्येष्वट्टाल केषु च
नानापण्यसमृद्धेषु वणिजामापणेषु च |
कुटुम्बिनां समृद्धेषु श्रीमत्सु भवनेषु च
सभासु चैव सर्वासु वृक्षेष्वालक्षितेएशु च |
ध्वजाः समुच्छ्रिताश्चित्राः पताकाश्चाभवंस्तदा
verses.iast:
sitābhraśikharābheśhu devatāyataneśhu ca |
�catuśhpadheśhu radhyāsu caityeśhvaṭṭāla keśhu ca
nānāpaṇyasamṛddheśhu vaṇijāmāpaṇeśhu ca |
kuṭumbināṃ samṛddheśhu śrīmatsu bhavaneśhu ca
sabhāsu caiva sarvāsu vṛkśeśhvālakśiteeśu ca |
dhvajāḥ samucchritāścitrāḥ patākāścābhavaṃstadā
verses.translation: Banners and colorful flags were hoisted on temples, which looked brilliantly like the silver lining of cloud, at road junctions, in streets, on big trees situated in temple compounds, from watching towers at city gates, on shops of wealthy merchants, on buildings of rich family persons, on all assembly halls and all visible trees.

glosses.meaning: which looked shiningly like the lining of a cloud
on big trees situated in temple-compounds
from watching towers in city gates
with a lot of saleable goods

verses.devanagari:
नटनर्तकसंघानां गायकानां च गायताम् |
मनःकर्णसुखा वाचः शुश्रुवुश्च ततस्ततः
verses.iast:
naṭanartakasaṅghānāṃ gāyakānāṃ ca gāyatām |
manaḥkarṇasukhā vācaḥ śuśruvuśca tatastataḥ
verses.translation: From different sides, actors were showing their talents, dancers were performing dance. Singers were singing and sweet voices were heard, pleasing the minds and ears.

glosses.meaning: pleasing to the minds and ears
from groups of actors and dancers

verses.devanagari:
रामाभिषेकयुक्ताश्च कथाश्चक्रुर्मिथो जनाः |
रामाभिषेके संप्रप्ते चत्वरेषु गृहेषु च
verses.iast:
rāmābhiśhekayuktāśca kathāścakrurmitho janāḥ |
rāmābhiśheke samprapte catvareśhu gṛheśhu ca
verses.translation: With Rama's anointment ceremony approaching, people were engaged in mutual conversations in their houses and at road junctions, about the ceremony.

verses.devanagari:
बाला अपि क्रीडमाना गृ हद्वारेषु संघशः |
रामाभिषवसंयुक्ताश्चक्रुरेवं मिथः कथाः
verses.iast:
bālā api krīḍamānā gṛ hadvāreśhu saṅghaśaḥ |
rāmābhiśhavasaṃyuktāścakrurevaṃ mithaḥ kathāḥ
verses.translation: Even children playing together before gateways of houses were telling each other, narratives of Rama's anointment ceremony.

verses.devanagari:
कृतपुष्पोपहारश्च धूपगन्धाधिवासितः |
राजमार्गः कृतः श्रीमान् पौरै रामाभिषेचने
verses.iast:
kṛtapuśhpopahāraśca dhūpagandhādhivāsitaḥ |
rājamārgaḥ kṛtaḥ śrīmān paurai rāmābhiśhecane
verses.translation: The citizens made king's road splendid, by sprinkling flowers on it and by making it good smelling with burning of incense and perfumes, on the occasion of Rama's anointment ceremony.

glosses.meaning: by making a sprinkle of flowers
and by making it good smelling from incense and perfumes
on the occasion of Rama's anointment ceremony.

verses.devanagari:
प्रकाशकरणार्धं च निशागमनशञ्कया |
दीपवृक्षां स्तथाचक्रु रनुर्थ्यसु सर्वशः
verses.iast:
prakāśakaraṇārdhaṃ ca niśāgamanaśaJṇkayā |
dīpavṛkśāṃ stathācakru ranurthyasu sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: On a doubt of approach of night on completion of the ceremony, they arranged lamps in the shape of trees to illuminate all the streets.

glosses.meaning: on doubt of arrival of night
lamps in the shape of trees

verses.devanagari:
अलङ्कारं पुरस्त्यवं कृत्वा तत्पुरवासिनः |
आकाङ्क्षमाणा रामस्य यौवराज्याभिषेचनम्
समेत्य संघशः सर्वे चत्वरेषु सभासु च |
कथयन्तो मिथस्तत्र प्रशशंसुर्जनाधिपम्
verses.iast:
alaṇ^kāraṃ purastyavaṃ kṛtvā tatpuravāsinaḥ |
ākāṇ^kśamāṇā rāmasya yauvarājyābhiśhecanam
sametya saṅghaśaḥ sarve catvareśhu sabhāsu ca |
kathayanto mithastatra praśaśaṃsurjanādhipam
verses.translation: All the citizens residing in Ayodhya, having thus decorated the city desiring Rama's coronation, gathered together in groups at road junctions and in assembly halls, mutually talking about this matter there and praising king Dasaratha.

verses.devanagari:
अहोओ महात्मा राजायमिक्ष्वाकुकुलनन्दनः |
ज्ञात्वा यो वृद्ध मात्मानं रामं राज्येऽभिषेक्ष्यति
verses.iast:
ahoo mahātmā rājāyamikśvākukulanandanaḥ |
jJṇātvā yo vṛddha mātmānaṃ rāmaṃ rājye'bhiśhekśyati
verses.translation: "O! This king Dasaratha, who delights Ikshvaaku dynasty, having known himself that he became aged, is going to anoint Rama for the kingdom. What a great man he is!"

verses.devanagari:
सर्वेऽप्यनुगृहीताः स्म यन्नो रामो महीपतिः |
चिराय भविता गोप्ता दृष्टलोकपरावरः
verses.iast:
sarve'pyanugṛhītāḥ sma yanno rāmo mahīpatiḥ |
cirāya bhavitā goptā dṛśhṭalokaparāvaraḥ
verses.translation: "Rama; who has seen the totality of the world is going to become our protector for long. We have all been blessed by king Dasaratha."

glosses.meaning: has seen the totality of the world

verses.devanagari:
आनुद्धतमना विद्वान् धर्मात्मा भ्रातृवत्सलः |
यधा च भ्रातृषु स्निग्धस्तथास्मास्वपि राघवः
verses.iast:
ānuddhatamanā vidvān dharmātmā bhrātṛvatsalaḥ |
yadhā ca bhrātṛśhu snigdhastathāsmāsvapi rāghavaḥ
verses.translation: "Rama is modest, knowledgeable and righteous. He is as compassionate to us as to his brothers."

glosses.meaning: who has no arrogance in his mind

verses.devanagari:
चिरं जीवतु धर्मात्मा राजा दशरथोऽनघः |
यत्प्रसादेनाभिषिक्तं रामं द्रक्ष्यामहे वयम्
verses.iast:
ciraṃ jīvatu dharmātmā rājā daśaratho'naghaḥ |
yatprasādenābhiśhiktaṃ rāmaṃ drakśyāmahe vayam
verses.translation: "Let the faultless and righteous king Dasaratha live long! Due to his blessings, we are going to see Rama as being anointed for the kingdom."

verses.devanagari:
एवंविधं कथयतां पौराणां शुश्रुवुस्तदा |
दिग्भ्योऽपि श्रुतवृत्तान्ताः प्राप्ताजानपदा नराः
verses.iast:
evaṃvidhaṃ kathayatāṃ paurāṇāṃ śuśruvustadā |
digbhyo'pi śrutavṛttāntāḥ prāptājānapadā narāḥ
verses.translation: The villagers, who came from different directions after hearing the news of coronation ceremony of Rama, listened to the narration of the citizens of Ayodhya.

verses.devanagari:
ते तु दिग्भ्यः पुरीं प्राप्ता द्रष्टुं रामाभिषेचनम् |
रामस्य पूरयामासुः पुरीं जानपदा जनाः
verses.iast:
te tu digbhyaḥ purīṃ prāptā draśhṭuṃ rāmābhiśhecanam |
rāmasya pūrayāmāsuḥ purīṃ jānapadā janāḥ
verses.translation: The city of Ayodhya was filled with villagers who came from different directions to see the anointment ceremony of Rama.

verses.devanagari:
जनौघै स्तैर्विसर्पद्भिः शुश्रुवे तत्र निस्वनः |
पर्वसूदीर्णवेगस्य सागरस्येव निस्वनः
verses.iast:
janaughai stairvisarpadbhiḥ śuśruve tatra nisvanaḥ |
parvasūdīrṇavegasya sāgarasyeva nisvanaḥ
verses.translation: The noise in the city was heard by the groups of those people, while moving here and there, as the roaring of an impetuous ocean on full moon days.

verses.devanagari:
ततस्तदिन्द्रक्षयसन्निभं पुरं |
दिदृक्षुभिर्जानपदै रुपागतैः |
समन्ततः सस्वनमाकुलं बभौ |
समुद्रयादोभि रिवार्णवोदकम्
verses.iast:
tatastadindrakśayasannibhaṃ puraṃ |
didṛkśubhirjānapadai rupāgataiḥ |
samantataḥ sasvanamākulaṃ babhau |
samudrayādobhi rivārṇavodakam
verses.translation: That city of Ayodhya equal to the residence of the celestial god Indra, disturbed with the sound being made all over by the villagers who came with the desire to see the ceremony, shone like a roaring ocean filled with sea animals.

glosses.meaning: equal to the residence of Indra (Amaravati)
